incidents.short_description: Ariba invoices not reaching SAP since this morning
incidents.description: Since about 06:00 CET none of the supplier invoices submitted on Ariba Network have arrived in SAP ECC. Suppliers can see them as Sent. About 140 invoices affected, payment run is tomorrow.

incidents.short_description: APAC invoice of SGD 15,000 approved without finance approval in Coupa
incidents.description: Invoice INV-SG-88213 for SGD 15,000 charged to APAC Operations was approved by the requester's manager only. Our policy says APAC invoices above SGD 10,000 must go to the APAC finance controller. This worked in the sandbox UAT last week.

incidents.short_description: ReadSoft not recognising supplier ACME Pte Ltd on scanned invoices
incidents.description: All scanned invoices from ACME Pte Ltd land in the exception queue with 'supplier not identified'. Started after ACME sent their new invoice template with their GST number at the top.

incidents.short_description: Ariba CIG invoice transfer to SAP failing
incidents.close_notes: Client certificate on the CIG ERP connection had expired. Renewed the certificate in the CIG portal, uploaded to SAP PI keystore, reprocessed failed documents from the transaction tracker.

incidents.short_description: Coupa approval not triggered for APAC invoices
incidents.close_notes: Approval rule existed only in sandbox. Replicated the rule and its approval chain to production after CAB approval.

incidents.short_description: ReadSoft supplier not identified after VAT number change
incidents.close_notes: Supplier master in ReadSoft still had the old VAT number. Updated supplier mapping and re-ran identification on queued documents.
